about: AMPL Capital Ltd (formerly Credent Global Finance Ltd; earlier Oracle Credit Ltd) is a BSE-listed, RBI-registered non-deposit-taking Base-Layer NBFC. The group provides SME/secured-business and gold loans, investment-banking/advisory, wealth management, PMS/AIF and real-estate advisory services. [1]
